title: Oral SERDs for ER-Positive, HER2-Negative Advanced Breast Cancer: FDA and EMA Approvals, Efficacy and Safety
summary: FDA and EMA approvals of oral SERDs for ESR1-mutated ER+/HER2- advanced breast cancer, with review findings on monotherapy and CDK4/6 combinations.
body_markdown:
## Oral SERDs for ER-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer: FDA and EMA approvals, efficacy and safety


Three oral selective estrogen receptor degraders (SERDs) now hold both FDA and EU authorisations for ER-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer: elacestrant (Orserdu), imlunestrant (Inluriyo) and camizestrant (Etcamah). All three are restricted to tumours with an *ESR1* mutation. They split into two regulatory models:


- **Monotherapy after endocrine progression.** Elacestrant and imlunestrant were approved on PFS benefit confined to the *ESR1* -mutated subgroup. Neither showed benefit in patients without a detected mutation.
- **ctDNA-guided switch with a CDK4/6 inhibitor.** Camizestrant is authorised in combination with a CDK4/6 inhibitor. Treatment switches when an *ESR1* mutation is detected during first-line aromatase inhibitor (AI) plus CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy, before disease progression.


Imlunestrant plus abemaciclib is where the agencies split. FDA added the combination to the US label in 2026. In the EU, the applicant withdrew the combination indication after CHMP raised major concerns about trial design.


### Approval landscape


Product (INN) FDA EMA Authorised use Pivotal trial CDK4/6 inhibitor status


Orserdu (elacestrant) NDA 217639, approved 27 Jan 2023[11](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=11) EMEA/H/C/005898, authorised 15 Sep 2023[1](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=1) Monotherapy, *ESR1* -mutated, after at least one line of endocrine therapy[246](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=246) . The EU requires that prior therapy included a CDK4/6 inhibitor[349](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=349) EMERALD (Study RAD1901-308)[218](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=218) Monotherapy only; used after CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy[178](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=178)


Inluriyo (imlunestrant) NDA 218881, approved 25 Sep 2025[10](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=10) EMEA/H/C/006184, authorised 9 Jan 2026[2](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=2) Monotherapy, *ESR1* -mutated, after endocrine therapy[61](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=61)[102](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=102) EMBER-3 (NCT04975308)[52](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=52) US: combination with abemaciclib added to the label[371](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=371) . EU: combination indication withdrawn[113](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=113)


Etcamah (camizestrant) NDA 220359, September 2026, accelerated approval[194](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=194)[374](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=374) EMEA/H/C/006494, authorised 20 Jul 2026[5](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=5) With palbociclib, ribociclib or abemaciclib when *ESR1* mutation is detected during first-line AI plus CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy[374](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=374)[137](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=137) SERENA-6[135](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=135)[363](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=363) Combination is the authorised regimen[137](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=137)


**Recommended doses (all once daily, oral).**


- **Elacestrant:** 345 mg with food[246](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=246) . The EU allows dose reduction to 258 mg[354](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=354) .
- **Imlunestrant:** 400 mg on an empty stomach[61](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=61) .
- **Camizestrant:** 75 mg with or without food, together with the CDK4/6 inhibitor at the dose the patient was already taking[374](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=374) .


**Wording differences between agencies.**


- EMA labelling calls elacestrant[356](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=356) and camizestrant[152](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=152) SERDs.
- The FDA labels for Orserdu and Etcamah use "estrogen receptor antagonist" wording, while describing ERα degradation for camizestrant[245](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=245)[376](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=376) .
- FDA materials explicitly call imlunestrant a SERD[54](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=54) .
- Both EU indications for imlunestrant and camizestrant require an LHRH agonist (camizestrant also allows an antagonist) for pre- or perimenopausal women and for men[115](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=115)[137](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=137) .


**A note on class boundaries.** FDA also approved vepdegestrant (Veppanu, NDA 219835) on 1 May 2026 for *ESR1* -mutated ER-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer after endocrine therapy[9](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=9)[124](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=124) . However, FDA gave it the established pharmacologic class "heterobifunctional protein degrader" (a PROTAC recruiting cereblon) and expressly distinguished it from SERDs[34](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=34)[123](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=123) . No EU authorisation was identified. For that reason it is discussed here only for context.


### Elacestrant (Orserdu)


#### Efficacy


EMERALD randomised 478 patients to elacestrant or standard-of-care endocrine monotherapy (investigator's choice of fulvestrant or an AI). PFS by blinded central review was the primary endpoint in both the overall population and the *ESR1* -mutated population (n=228)[218](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=218)[230](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=230) .


Population Elacestrant median PFS SOC median PFS HR (95% CI)


*ESR1* -mutated 3.78 months 1.87 months 0.546 (0.387 to 0.768); p=0.0005[230](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=230)


Overall ITT 2.79 months 1.91 months 0.697 (0.552 to 0.880); p=0.0018[230](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=230)


*ESR1* not detected 1.94 months 1.97 months 0.863 (0.628 to 1.186); p=0.3082[217](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=217)


**FDA view of the overall-population result.** FDA concluded that the ITT result was driven by the 48% of patients with *ESR1* mutations. It found no clinically meaningful benefit in the mutation-not-detected subgroup, especially given the added gastrointestinal toxicity[232](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=232) .


**Overall survival.** OS in the *ESR1* -mutated population was not statistically significant. The label reports HR 0.90 (95% CI 0.63 to 1.30)[218](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=218) . The EPAR reports median OS of 24.18 versus 23.49 months[291](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=291) .


**Efficacy after prior CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy.** All *ESR1* -mutated patients in EMERALD had received a CDK4/6 inhibitor before enrolment[230](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=230) . The EPAR reports an exploratory trend: benefit was larger with longer prior CDK4/6 inhibitor exposure. With at least 12 months of prior exposure, median PFS was 8.61 versus 1.91 months (HR 0.41)[182](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=182) . Even so, the EPAR states that the effect of prior CDK4/6 inhibition on elacestrant activity cannot be determined from the submitted data[186](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=186)[192](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=192) .


**Combination data.** No clinical data support combining elacestrant with a CDK4/6 inhibitor. The only combination evidence is a preclinical palbociclib xenograft study[185](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=185) .


**Assessment issue flagged in the EPAR.** Investigators and central review disagreed on progression. Investigators called progression earlier than central review in 32.6% of elacestrant patients versus 22.7% of SOC patients[292](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=292) . Sensitivity analyses remained supportive[297](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=297) .


#### Safety


Grade 3 to 4 treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs) occurred in 27.0% of patients (treatment-related: 7.2%)[279](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=279) . Other key findings:


- **Common adverse reactions:** musculoskeletal pain (41%), nausea (35%), fatigue (26%) and vomiting (19%)[268](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=268) .
- **Gastrointestinal excess versus SOC:** nausea 35% vs 19%, vomiting 19% vs 9%[284](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=284) .
- **Serious and fatal adverse reactions:** serious in 12%; fatal in 1.7%, none considered treatment-related[268](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=268)[279](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=279) .
- **Treatment modifications:** permanent discontinuation 6%, dose interruption 15%, dose reduction 3%[268](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=268) .
- **FDA warnings and precautions:** dyslipidemia (hypercholesterolemia 30%, hypertriglyceridemia 27%) and embryo-fetal toxicity[271](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=271)[275](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=275) .
- **EU risk management:** the RMP listed no important identified or potential risks. CHMP highlighted gastrointestinal events, hepatic impairment, CYP3A4 interactions and venous thromboembolism as precautions[325](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=325)[332](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=332) .


### Imlunestrant (Inluriyo)


#### Monotherapy efficacy


EMBER-3 was an open-label phase 3 trial with three arms randomised 1:1:1:


- imlunestrant monotherapy
- investigator's-choice fulvestrant or exemestane
- imlunestrant plus abemaciclib[52](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=52)[103](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=103)


Patients had progressed on an AI, with or without a CDK4/6 inhibitor. PFS in the ITT and *ESR1* -mutated populations were dual primary endpoints[62](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=62)[86](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=86) .


Population Imlunestrant Comparator HR (95% CI)


*ESR1* -mutated (n=256) 5.5 months 3.8 months 0.62 (0.46 to 0.82); p=0.0008[62](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=62)


Overall ITT Not statistically significant[86](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=86)


*ESR1* not detected (FDA exploratory) 5.6 months 5.6 months 1.04 (0.82 to 1.33)[86](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=86)


**Supporting analyses.** Blinded central review in the *ESR1* -mutated population gave HR 0.657[320](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=320) .


**Overall survival.** OS was immature and not statistically significant. FDA found no evidence of OS detriment and required a postmarketing commitment for further OS analyses[51](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=51)[50](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=50) . Formal OS testing in the ITT population was not possible because the ITT PFS endpoint failed[317](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=317) .


**CHMP criticisms of the trial.** CHMP noted three limitations:


- *ESR1* status was not a randomisation stratification factor[103](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=103) .
- The enrolled population was fitter than patients seen in routine practice[103](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=103) .
- 32 patients were inadvertently enrolled in the *ESR1* -mutated population. Excluding them gave HR 0.541[316](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=316) .


#### Monotherapy safety


Grade 3 or higher TEAEs occurred in 17.1% of patients, versus 20.7% with SOC[341](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=341)[76](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=76) . Other key findings:


- **Common adverse reactions:** musculoskeletal pain (30%), fatigue (23%), diarrhoea (22%) and nausea (17%)[334](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=334) .
- **Excess versus control:** gastrointestinal events and fatigue were more frequent (diarrhoea 22% vs 12%, fatigue 23% vs 14%)[59](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=59) .
- **Serious and fatal adverse reactions:** serious in 10%; fatal in 1.8%[335](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=335) .
- **Treatment modifications:** discontinuation 4.6%, dose reduction 2.4%[335](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=335) .
- **US label:** the only warning and precaution is embryo-fetal toxicity[335](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=335) .


**EU-specific safety conclusions.** CHMP classified venous thromboembolism as a common adverse drug reaction[79](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=79)[84](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=84) . Three deaths from gastrointestinal bleeding were treated as a novel signal. Gastrointestinal bleeding was therefore added to the RMP as an important potential risk and a PSUR safety concern[79](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=79) .


#### Imlunestrant plus abemaciclib: divergent FDA and EMA outcomes


**Original FDA review.** FDA's 2025 review did not assess the combination arm. The proposed indication was monotherapy, so the combination was outside the NDA's scope[303](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=303)[305](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=305) .


**2026 US labelling update.** The label now includes Inluriyo with abemaciclib for adults with *ESR1* -mutated ER-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer after at least one line of endocrine therapy[371](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=371) . The supporting efficacy analysis was exploratory. In the *ESR1* -mutated population (n=159), median PFS was 11.1 months with the combination versus 5.5 months with imlunestrant alone (HR 0.53, 95% CI 0.35 to 0.80)[370](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=370)[96](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=96) .


**Combination safety in the US label (n=208).**


- **Common clinical adverse reactions:** diarrhoea 86% (grade 3 to 4: 9%), nausea 51% and fatigue 41%[338](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=338) .
- **Serious and fatal adverse reactions:** serious in 21%; fatal in 3.8%[338](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=338) .
- **Treatment modifications:** dose interruption 50%, dose reduction 18%[338](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=338) .
- **Laboratory abnormalities:** neutrophil decrease in 86% (grade 3 to 4: 21%)[311](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=311) .


**EU outcome.** The applicant withdrew the combination indication during assessment[113](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=113)[199](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=199) . Across the concurrently randomised ITT population, the combination improved investigator-assessed PFS over imlunestrant alone: 9.36 versus 5.49 months (HR 0.569)[366](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=366)[368](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=368) . In CDK4/6 inhibitor-pretreated patients the difference was 9.1 versus 3.7 months[367](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=367) . CHMP nonetheless raised the following concerns:


- **Wrong primary comparison.** Imlunestrant monotherapy had not beaten SOC in the ITT population, and the combination was compared with SOC only in exploratory analyses[366](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=366) .
- **Contribution of components not shown.** The design could not isolate imlunestrant's added benefit on top of abemaciclib[366](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=366) .
- **Wrong comparator for CDK4/6 inhibitor-naive patients.** Median PFS was identical in both arms (11.1 months), and the trial did not compare the combination with abemaciclib plus fulvestrant[367](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=367) .
- **Assessment bias.** Open-label, investigator-assessed PFS carried a risk of ascertainment bias[367](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=367) .
- **Missing supporting data.** No CDK4/6 inhibitor rechallenge data and no combination dose-finding were submitted[199](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=199)[367](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=367) .
- **Immature OS.** OS was not significant (HR 0.824, p=0.262)[366](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=366)[368](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=368) .
- **Tolerability.** Dose interruptions or reductions were substantially more frequent with the combination[75](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=75) .


### Camizestrant (Etcamah)


#### Efficacy with CDK4/6 inhibitors


**SERENA-6 design.** SERENA-6 was a double-blind trial that randomised 315 patients 1:1[135](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=135) . All patients had a plasma ctDNA *ESR1* mutation detected after at least 6 months of first-line AI plus CDK4/6 inhibitor therapy without progression. The arms were:


- switch to camizestrant, keeping the same CDK4/6 inhibitor
- continue the AI plus CDK4/6 inhibitor


The CDK4/6 inhibitors in use were palbociclib (75.6%), ribociclib (14.9%) and abemaciclib (9.5%). The primary endpoint was investigator-assessed PFS[135](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=135) .


**PFS results.**


- EPAR: 16.76 versus 9.23 months (HR 0.45, 95% CI 0.34 to 0.59; p<0.00001)[198](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=198) .
- US label: 16.0 versus 9.2 months (HR 0.44, 95% CI 0.31 to 0.60)[363](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=363) .


**Overall survival.** OS was immature. The EPAR reports HR 0.87 (95% CI 0.57 to 1.30) at 30% maturity[198](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=198) . The FDA label reports 12% maturity at the PFS analysis[363](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=363) . Final OS is an EU post-authorisation obligation due by 31 December 2028[139](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=139) .


**US approval terms.** FDA granted accelerated approval based on PFS measured from *ESR1* mutation detection[374](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=374)[377](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=377) . The label specifies:


- ctDNA testing every 3 months until a mutation is detected[374](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=374)
- a plasma *ESR1* mutation detected with an FDA-authorised test[374](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=374)


**Retrieved materials do not address the switch strategy itself.** Neither the retrieved FDA review nor the retrieved EPAR text discusses whether switching early on ctDNA detection is better than switching at progression, or how PFS2 findings were interpreted[363](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=363)[150](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=150) . These are the central open questions for this indication.


#### Safety


Safety data come from the pooled EU dataset of camizestrant plus a CDK4/6 inhibitor (n=263) and from SERENA-6 in the US label (n=155).


- **Most common adverse reactions (EU):** neutropenia 59.7% (grade 3 to 4: 46.4%), visual effects 40.7%, infections 38.4% and bradycardia 19.8%[146](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=146) .
- **US label:** visual disturbances in 34% (photopsia, blurred vision and related terms) and bradycardia in 8%. Mean heart-rate decrease was about 13 bpm, with the maximum at Day 15[379](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=379)[380](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=380) .
- **Serious and fatal adverse reactions (US):** serious in 10%; fatal in 1.3%[379](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=379)[380](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=380) .
- **Treatment modifications (US):** camizestrant discontinuation 1.3%, dose interruption 22%[379](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=379) .
- **US boxed warning and warnings and precautions:** Boxed warning for arrhythmia risk (Torsades de Pointes, other ventricular arrhythmias, and sudden death) when used with QTc-prolonging drugs such as ribociclib. Section 5 warnings and precautions are QTc interval prolongation, bradycardia, and embryo-fetal toxicity. Visual disturbances are adverse reactions with dose-modification guidance, not a numbered warning and precaution[377](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=377)[378](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=378)[380](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=380) .
- **Exposure-response:** higher camizestrant exposure was associated with more bradycardia and visual disturbance[376](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=376) .
- **EU assessment:** EMA regarded bradycardia and visual disturbances as camizestrant-specific effects that warnings and monitoring can manage. Most serious events were attributed to known CDK4/6 inhibitor effects[149](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=149) . The EPAR also reports QTc prolongation in 6.8%, including one grade 4 non-fatal Torsades de Pointes event with ribociclib[145](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=145)[152](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=152) .


### Cross-product observations for regulatory strategy


- ***ESR1* restriction is consistent across products and agencies.** In every pivotal monotherapy trial, the *ESR1* -not-detected subgroup had HRs near or above 1[217](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=217)[86](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=86)[316](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=316) . The EU restriction for imlunestrant was explicitly tied to this differential efficacy[314](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=314) .
- **Companion diagnostics.** US labels require an FDA-authorised plasma test[246](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=246)[61](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=61)[374](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=374) . EU labels allow a CE-marked IVD or another validated test if no IVD is available[354](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=354)[115](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=115) .
- **Monotherapy PFS gains were modest.** Median PFS improvements in the *ESR1* -mutated population were about 1.6 to 1.9 months[192](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=192)[317](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=317) . OS was immature or not significant at approval for every product. FDA required postmarketing OS analyses for imlunestrant[50](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=50) , and the EU imposed a post-authorisation OS obligation for camizestrant[139](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=139) .
- **Safety profiles differ by agent.**


- Elacestrant: gastrointestinal toxicity and dyslipidemia[284](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=284)[271](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=271) .
- Imlunestrant: gastrointestinal toxicity and fatigue, with venous thromboembolism and gastrointestinal bleeding flagged in the EU[59](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=59)[79](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=79) .
- Camizestrant: bradycardia, visual disturbances and QTc effects on top of the CDK4/6 inhibitor's cytopenias[146](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=146)[380](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=380) .


- **Combination evidence is judged differently.** FDA accepted exploratory *ESR1* -mutated PFS data for imlunestrant plus abemaciclib[370](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=370)[96](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=96) . CHMP required the combination to be compared against SOC, the contribution of each component to be shown, and dose-finding data[366](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=366)[199](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=199) . SERENA-6 met both agencies' expectations because it used a double-blind active control against the same CDK4/6 inhibitor backbone[135](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=135) .


### Open questions


Several points could not be answered from the retrieved review text and would support deeper follow-up:


- FDA's reasoning on the ctDNA-guided switch paradigm for camizestrant, including PFS2 and patient-reported outcomes.
- The exact approval action and date for the US imlunestrant plus abemaciclib supplement.
- Reconciliation of the differing OS hazard ratios reported across FDA review documents for elacestrant and imlunestrant[222](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=222)[218](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=218)[86](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=86)[51](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/oral-serds-for-er-positive-her2-negative-advanced?showSourceNumber=51) .
